rate_limits: Without key: 240 req/min, 1,000/day (per IP). With key: 240 req/min, 120,000/day (per key).
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Official openFDA authentication docs (https://open.fda.gov/apis/authentication/) state no-key limits are 240 req/min and 1,000/day per IP (not 40/min); keyed limits remain 240/min and 120,000/day per key. Original unauthenticated per-minute figure was stale.
